title: Belief Transfer
equation: Leadership Power = Vision Clarity × Trust × Emotional Conviction
hook: Your team doesn't just need a task list. They need to believe the hard work leads somewhere.
statement: Leadership is helping people believe in a bigger, better future than the one they can see right now.
explainer: This isn't fake positivity. A leader takes in the uncertainty and turns it into direction. People do their best work when they get the meaning and context, not just the to-dos.
sop: Define the better future you're building toward.
Show each person how their role connects to it.
Repeat the vision often, and keep it consistent.
Back it up with action and proof.
equation_example: Vision Clarity 7, Trust 6, Emotional Conviction 8. 7 × 6 × 8 = 336 Leadership Power, out of 1,000. Higher means people act with courage when you're not in the room. Lower means they're doing tasks without believing where they lead.
question: Write the future you need your team to believe in, in two sentences.
closing_statement: People follow belief before they follow instructions.
